frozenAfter: the historical arm closed, so historical results cannot bias this arm's scope

provider.note: the same provider the historical arm used; changing it here would make the two arms incomparable and would re-open the selection decision after results were seen

executionPath.note: the ordinary product path, not a bespoke evaluator; production-path mechanics (budget, checkpointing, admission, scope) all apply

repositorySelectionRationale: the full admitted eight-repository universe, taken as a whole rather than chosen for suspected defect content. No repository was selected because a defect is believed to be there; no current-source ground truth was seeded from the historical corpus, issue trackers, PR titles or fix commits.

runs.purpose: measure unknown-source yield across the whole admitted universe

concentrate budget on the ONLY repository with deterministic reproduction capability (1,120 executable files / 152 targets), so a reproducible current-source failure has its best measured chance of being found
prove a widened resume of a scoped campaign fails closed rather than silently investigating more than it was frozen to
prove a resume under the identical frozen scope continues under the checkpoint's own stored budget policy

budget.stoppingCondition: each run ends on its own HOUR_1 budget ceiling or terminal campaign state; the arm ends when the frozen runs above have each reached a terminal state. The arm is NOT extended to chase a non-zero result.

reproductionClasses.executionBreadthLimit: deterministic reproduction is available in mobingilabs/ouchan only; the other seven repositories are investigable but have zero executable targets

leakageRule.currentSourceGroundTruthSeeding: PROHIBITED — no seeding from historical corpus, issue tracker, PR titles or fix commits

previouslyUnknownClassification.strongerClaimRequiresSeparateEvidence: PREVIOUSLY_UNKNOWN_ALPHAUS_BUG is not claimed on the strength of a mechanical admission alone
